statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once and put d_T=6-r_T. Suppose R=226, every d_T is in {0,1,2,3}, exactly two actual triangles have deficiency three, those two triangles are disjoint, and b counts deficiency-two triangles. Then b is not three.
assumptions: R=226 counts actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once
d_T=6-r_T belongs to {0,1,2,3} for every actual triangle
exactly two actual d3 triangles, pairwise disjoint

scope.description: Conditional exclusion of disjoint c2/b3 at R226/maxd3.

exact_case_coverage.h2_high_graph: two actual high triangles sharing the middle d2 root

outline_correction.reason: I2/x1 opposite low contributes binom(3,2)=3, exceeding1+1.5x; use q_I2+2*sumx<=8+8.

limitations: Literal disjointness and maxd3 are assumptions, not inferred here.
The valid local high triangle and all allowed selected incidences/extra edges are retained.
